events.description: Completed the acquisition of Wright Medical Group N.V. (Wright) for $30.75 per share, or an aggregate purchase price of $4.1 billion ($5.6 billion including convertible notes). Wright is part of the Trauma and Extremities business within Orthopaedics.
events.source_quote: In November 2020 we completed the acquisition of Wright Medical Group N.V. (Wright) for $ 30.75 per share, or an aggregate purchase price of $ 4.1 billion ($ 5.6 billion including convertible notes).

events.description: Completed the acquisition of OrthoSensor, Inc. (OrthoSensor), a leader in the digital evolution of musculoskeletal care and sensor technology for total joint replacement, which became part of the Joint Replacement business within Orthopaedics.
events.source_quote: In December 2020 we completed the acquisition of OrthoSensor, Inc. (OrthoSensor).

events.description: Completed various other acquisitions in the first six months of 2021 for an aggregate purchase price of $108 million, net of cash acquired.
events.source_quote: The aggregate purchase price of our acquisitions, net of cash acquired was $ 108 and $ 26 in the six months 2021 and 2020.

events.description: Repaid/retired the 2.625% Senior Unsecured Notes which matured on March 15, 2021, and had an outstanding principal balance of $750 million as of December 31, 2020.
Declared cash dividends of $0.63 per share of common stock for the three months ended June 30, 2021 and $1.26 per share for the six months ended June 30, 2021.
events.source_quote: Cash dividends declared per share of common stock $ 0.63 [Three Months 2021] ... $ 1.26 [Six Months 2021]

events.description: Issued 3,231 shares of common stock as performance incentive awards to employees during the three months ended June 30, 2021.
events.source_quote: We issued 3,231 shares of our common stock in the three months 2021 as performance incentive awards to employees.
